purpose: Score-blind recovery of task or arm protocol errors from the completed 1,534-task v4 run without rerunning clean tasks.

error_account.selection_rule: A task is selected if and only if its original record contains task_error or any arm termination equal to arm_error. Accuracy and other outcomes are not inspected for selection.

recovery_policy.unit: Entire five-arm task, including a newly sampled shared initial SQL.
recovery_policy.reason: Rerunning the whole task preserves the shared-prefix pairing and avoids selectively replacing only an unfavourable arm.
recovery_policy.archive: Before recovery, preserve the original run manifest, merged JSONL, analysis, and all 39 affected task records under recovery/attempt-01/original-invalid-run.
recovery_policy.reuse: The unchanged runner validates and reuses all 1,495 unaffected task records.
recovery_policy.attempts: Run one recovery attempt, then stop and audit. No automatic retry is authorized if protocol errors remain.
recovery_policy.outcome_blinding: Do not use success, SQL content, user turns, or score when deciding which records to replace.
